creator: Alexander Terp
description:
On 0.28.0 a stuck Codex 0.170.0 pane on remote Linux was restarted; the daemon launched `codex resume` with the original id. Before any prompt in the resumed session, `muster window --json` showed `adapter: silent`, `session: null`, `resume: null`, and Restart Agent was grayed out (the menu gates on `resumesAs` in Sources/MusterMac/MusterWindow.swift). The first submitted prompt produced `session.id.reported` and filled both.

Keep the verified session id and resume command through an explicit restart until the resumed harness reports a new identity or exits. Test two consecutive restarts with the second before any prompt. Related: a_2uStCtx9Q, and the stuck card filed with this one. From tooling feedback a_32h3YfcNY.
title: Restarting a Codex pane clears its session until its first prompt, leaving Restart Agent disabled
